chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Musa ibn Al-Qasim, who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far the Second (peace be upon him): 'I intended to circumambulate on your behalf and on behalf of your father.' So it was said to me: 'The successors are such that circumambulations are not to be performed on their behalf.' So he said to me: 'But, circumambulate whatever you are able to, for it is allowed.'

Then I said to him after that by three years: 'I had sought your permission regarding the circumambulation on your behalf, and on behalf of your father, so you permitted me with regards to that. So I circumambulated on behalf of you both what Allah so Desired. Then something occurred in my heart, so I acted by it.' He said: 'And what was it?' I said, 'I circumambulated one day, on behalf of Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family).' So he said three times: 'May Allah send Blessings upon Rasool-Allah.'

Then on the second day, on behalf of Amir Al-Momineen. Then on the third day I circumambulated on behalf of Al-Hasan (peace be upon him); and on the fourth day on behalf of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him); and on the fifth day on behalf of Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him); and on the sixth day on behalf of Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him); and on the seventh day on behalf of Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him); and on the eighth day on behalf of your father Musa (peace be upon him); and on the ninth day on behalf of your father Ali (peace be upon him), and on the tenth day on your behalf, my Master. And they are those whom I make to be a Religion of Allah, by their Wilayah.

So he said: 'Then, by Allah, you have made a Religion of Allah with the Religion which He will not be Accepting from the servants, apart from it.' I said, 'And sometimes I circumambulate on behalf of your mother Fatima (peace be upon her), and sometimes I do not circumambulate.' So he said: 'Frequent from this, for it would be the most superior of what you act upon, Allah Willing.'

key_terms.أَدِينُ اللَّهَ: I make a Religion of Allah (I adhere to their Wilayah as a religious duty)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform Tawaf on behalf of the Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the jurisprudential permissibility of *Tawaf al-Nawafil* (voluntary circumambulation) performed on behalf of the Imams, a practice rooted in the concept of *Welayah* (spiritual guardianship). The Ninth Imam’s emphatic approval—'Increase in this, for it is the best of your deeds'—highlights the theological significance of honoring the Ahl al-Bayt through ritual acts, linking physical devotion to spiritual allegiance. It serves as a key textual basis for Shia devotional practices where the faithful perform rituals to earn reward for the Imams, reinforcing their status as intercessors and spiritual guides.
